name: AdGuard Home
description: Blocks ads and trackers for every device that uses this machine as its DNS server.

volumes.name: work
volumes.purpose: query log, statistics and filter lists

volumes.name: conf
volumes.purpose: configuration, including the admin password hash

next_steps: Open http://<this machine>:3000 and complete the setup wizard.
In the wizard, keep the admin web interface on port 3000 (it suggests 80): CaratCore only publishes port 3000.
Then set this machine as the DNS server of your router or of each device.
remove_warning: if your router, your devices or Tailscale use this machine as their DNS server, they will stop resolving names; point them to another DNS server first

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Checks that your services and websites are up and alerts you when one goes down.

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: monitors, history and the admin account

next_steps: Open http://<this machine>:3001 and create the admin account.
Add a monitor for each service you want to watch, for example AdGuard Home on port 3000.
